info.title: Voice Gateway v2 API Reference
info.description: RESTful JSON signaling API served at `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/`.

get.description: Lists available voice choices and their supported transports.

post.description: Exchanges a WebRTC SDP offer for an answer, opening a voice gateway session.
Closes a WebRTC voice bridge session.
Returns structured WebRTC connectivity diagnostics for a voice bridge session.
Authorizes a browser text-session upgrade with a short-lived, single-use ticket.

AssistantTextDelta.description:
AssistantTextDelta is a gateway message that streams assistant text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

responseID.description:
ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry.

text.description: Text is an incremental assistant text fragment.

Context.description: Context carries provider-neutral text or instruction context.

systemInstruction.description: SystemInstruction is provider-neutral instruction text for the assistant.

text.description: Text is additional conversational context for the session.

ContextUpdate.description:
ContextUpdate is a client message that appends session context.
Context is passive unless Generate explicitly requests an assistant response.

context.description: Context contains the instructions or text to append.

generate.description: Generate requests a response to this service update, without recording user speech.

Error.description: Error is a gateway message that reports an error.

message.description: Message is a human-readable error description.

recoverable.description: Recoverable reports whether the client may continue using the session.

ErrorCode.description: ErrorCode is a machine-readable API error identifier.

InterruptSource.description:
InterruptSource identifies why a voice gateway turn was interrupted.

- `user`: InterruptSourceUser means user speech interrupted the assistant.
- `tool`: InterruptSourceTool means tool execution was cancelled.

Interrupted.description: Interrupted is a gateway message that reports an interruption.

message.description: Message optionally provides more detail about the interruption.

source.description: Source identifies what interrupted the turn.

MessageEnvelope.description: MessageEnvelope carries the kind used to dispatch data-channel messages.

kind.description: Kind is the message discriminator used to decode the concrete message type.

MessageKind.description:
MessageKind identifies a voice gateway WebRTC data-channel message.

- `session.setup`: MessageKindSessionSetup starts a provider-neutral voice session.
- `context.update`: MessageKindContextUpdate sends provider-neutral text context to the session.
- `user.message`: MessageKindUserMessage appends completed user text and asks the assistant to respond.
- `tool.result`: MessageKindToolResult returns the result of a tool call.
- `turn.cancel`: MessageKindTurnCancel asks the gateway to cancel the current turn.
- `session.close`: MessageKindSessionClose asks the gateway to close the session.
- `rtc.answer`: MessageKindRTCAnswer answers the gateway's rtc.offer.
- `session.ready`: MessageKindSessionReady reports that the gateway session is ready.
- `session.status`: MessageKindSessionStatus reports startup progress before session.ready.
- `session.usage`: MessageKindSessionUsage reports cumulative provider usage for this connection.
- `rtc.offer`: MessageKindRTCOffer renegotiates the WebRTC media session.
- `transcript.delta`: MessageKindTranscriptDelta streams transcript text.
- `transcript.draft`: MessageKindTranscriptDraft replaces provisional user text, without committing it.
- `assistant.text.delta`: MessageKindAssistantTextDelta streams assistant text.
- `reasoning.delta`: MessageKindReasoningDelta streams provider reasoning text.
- `speech.started`: MessageKindSpeechStarted reports that speech output started.
- `speech.ended`: MessageKindSpeechEnded reports that speech output ended.
- `user.speech.started`: MessageKindUserSpeechStarted reports that the gateway detected the start of user speech.
- `tool.call`: MessageKindToolCall asks the client to execute a tool.
- `turn.status`: MessageKindTurnStatus reports gateway work on the current turn.
- `interrupted`: MessageKindInterrupted reports an interruption.
- `error`: MessageKindError reports a gateway error.

RTCAnswer.description: RTCAnswer is a client message that answers rtc.offer.

sdp.description: SDP is the client's SDP answer.

RTCOffer.description:
RTCOffer is a gateway message that renegotiates the WebRTC media session.

The gateway sends at most one, after session.ready, and only to a client
whose session.setup set renegotiation. The client applies it as the remote
description and replies with rtc.answer; until then the session keeps its
current media parameters.

sdp.description: SDP is the gateway's SDP offer.

ReasoningDelta.description:
ReasoningDelta is a gateway message that streams provider reasoning text.

Reasoning is not speech and not a transcript statement. A client decides
whether to display it, but must not speak it or replay it as recovery context.
The gateway includes it in the session activity log.

responseID.description:
ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry.

text.description: Text is an incremental reasoning fragment.

RecognitionModel.description:
RecognitionModel identifies one configured recognition stage without
exposing endpoints or credentials.

id.description:
ID is the operator-configured id; it stays the same while the stage's
settings change.

ServiceAuthorization.description: ServiceAuthorization identifies the host and carries its scoped gateway token.

SessionClose.description: SessionClose is a client message that closes the voice session.

reason.description: Reason optionally explains why the client closed the session.

SessionReady.description:
SessionReady is a gateway message that reports the session is ready.

The gateway sends it before any turn and does not follow it with
turn.status idle: clients that capture speech start listening on
session.ready unless they request a response first.

SessionSetup.description: SessionSetup is the client message that initializes a voice session.

context.description: Context provides initial instructions or text context for the session.

includeReasoning.description:
IncludeReasoning requests optional provider reasoning output for this session.
It does not enable thinking or change reasoning effort.

recognitionModelID.description:
RecognitionModelID selects a recognitionModels entry for a composable LLM.
Omitted uses the first available entry when input is gateway-owned.
It must be omitted for client-owned recognition and indivisible choices.

renegotiation.description:
Renegotiation declares that the client answers rtc.offer. The gateway then
sends one after session.ready when the session takes microphone audio
below 48 kHz, capping the client's Opus encoder with RFC 7587
maxplaybackrate so it stops spending uplink bits on audio the backend
discards. It applies only to WebRTC sessions.

speech.description: Speech selects the owner of recognition and synthesis for this session.

synthesisModelID.description:
SynthesisModelID selects a synthesisModels entry for a composable LLM.
Omitted uses the first available entry when output is gateway-owned.
It must be omitted for client-owned synthesis and indivisible choices.

tools.description: Tools declares the client-side tools the assistant may call.

voice.description: Voice contains the requested voice and language.

SessionStatus.description:
SessionStatus reports startup progress. Gateways repeat it at least every five
seconds while loading or waiting for capacity. Clients may refresh their
setup timeout on receipt; only session.ready enables microphone input.

message.description: Message is a short user-visible description of startup work.

SessionUsage.description:
SessionUsage is an idempotent snapshot for one gateway connection. Clients
replace snapshots with the same SessionID and carry totals across automatic
reconnects in one conversation. Missing reports are excluded from totals;
this is observed model usage, not a billing statement or ASR/TTS accounting.

contextTokens.description: ContextTokens is the latest reported context size, never summed.

contextWindow.description: ContextWindow is the latest reported context capacity.

lastResponse.description: LastResponse contains the latest reported response counts, when available.

responseID.description:
ResponseID identifies the response observed by this report. It is opaque
and unique across gateway connections. Empty means the provider did not
supply a reliable response association.

responseUsage.description:
ResponseUsage contains counts for ResponseID in this report only. Unlike
LastResponse, it is never carried forward into context-only reports.

sessionID.description: SessionID identifies the gateway connection that owns these totals.

totals.description: Totals sums all reported responses, including tool continuations.

Speaker.description:
Speaker identifies a transcript or speech speaker.

- `user`: SpeakerUser is the human speaker.
- `assistant`: SpeakerAssistant is the assistant speaker.

SpeechConfig.description:
SpeechConfig selects recognition and synthesis independently. Empty fields use
transport defaults: WebRTC uses each configured gateway stage; text uses client
speech. Explicit unsupported selections fail before model initialization.

SpeechEnded.description: SpeechEnded is a gateway message that reports speech output ended.

speaker.description: Speaker identifies whose speech output ended.

SpeechLocation.description:
SpeechLocation identifies which side owns a speech stage.

- `client`: SpeechLocationClient uses the client's speech facilities.
- `gateway`: SpeechLocationGateway uses the gateway's configured speech model.

SpeechStarted.description: SpeechStarted is a gateway message that reports speech output started.

speaker.description: Speaker identifies whose speech output started.

StatusResp.description: StatusResp is a common response for mutation endpoints.

status.description: Status is a short human-readable result such as "closed".

SynthesisModel.description:
SynthesisModel identifies one configured synthesis stage without exposing
endpoints or credentials.

id.description:
ID is the operator-configured id; it stays the same while the stage's
settings change.

voices.description:
Voices lists the selectable voices. Omitted when the stage offers no
voice selection.

TokenUsage.description:
TokenUsage contains provider-reported counts. Nil means unavailable. Cached
and reasoning counts are breakdowns, never additional tokens to sum with input
and output; providers differ in how they account for reasoning output.

cachedTokens.description: CachedTokens is the reported cached-input breakdown.

inputTokens.description: InputTokens includes the input processed again on each model request.

outputTokens.description: OutputTokens counts generated output as reported by the provider.

reasoningTokens.description: ReasoningTokens is the reported reasoning breakdown.

ToolCall.description: ToolCall is a gateway message that asks the client to execute a tool.

args.description: Args is the JSON argument object for the requested tool.

id.description: ID uniquely identifies this tool call for the matching tool.result.

name.description: Name is the requested tool name.

ToolDeclaration.description: ToolDeclaration is a provider-neutral service tool declaration.

description.description: Description explains when and how the assistant should use the tool.

name.description: Name is the tool name the assistant uses in tool.call messages.

parameters.description:
Parameters is a JSON Schema object describing the tool arguments. When
present, it must declare "type": "object".

ToolResult.description: ToolResult is a client message that returns a tool execution result.

id.description: ID matches the tool.call ID being answered.

ignoreNextMicrophoneTurn.description:
IgnoreNextMicrophoneTurn asks the RTC gateway to discard one detected
microphone utterance before sending audio to the backend. The client
keeps its microphone off while the assistant finishes the current reply.

name.description: Name is the tool name that produced the result.

result.description: Result is the JSON result returned to the assistant.

TranscriptDelta.description:
TranscriptDelta is a gateway message that streams transcript text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

draft_id.description: DraftID atomically replaces the matching user draft when this text commits.

responseID.description:
ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry.

speaker.description: Speaker identifies who produced this transcript text.

text.description: Text is an incremental transcript fragment.

TranscriptDraft.description:
TranscriptDraft is an ephemeral full-text user hypothesis for one microphone
utterance. Revisions replace text for ID. Empty Text clears only that ID.
Drafts never enter conversation history, activity logs, or recovery context.

TurnCancel.description: TurnCancel is a client message that cancels the current turn.

reason.description: Reason optionally explains why the current assistant turn was cancelled.

TurnState.description:
TurnState identifies the gateway work that precedes assistant output.

- `idle`: TurnStateIdle means the gateway has no turn in progress.
- `thinking`: TurnStateThinking means the assistant is generating a response.
- `transcribing`: TurnStateTranscribing means the gateway is converting user speech to text.

TurnStatus.description:
TurnStatus is a gateway message that reports work on the current turn.

Backends that cannot observe their own progress never send it. Speech
output and tool calls take display precedence over the reported state.

state.description:
State is the gateway work in progress; idle ends the turn, including
one that produced no speech.

UserMessage.description: UserMessage is a client message that appends completed user text and asks the assistant to respond.

text.description: Text is the completed user utterance to send to the assistant.

UserSpeechStarted.description:
UserSpeechStarted is a gateway message that reports the start of user speech
that the gateway's voice activity detection, or its realtime provider's,
detected: the start of a new user turn.

The gateway sends it in order with its other messages, before anything it
sends in reply to that speech. A user transcript.delta gives no such order:
a realtime provider transcribes user audio apart from its responses, so the
transcript of the speech that caused a tool call can arrive after the tool
call or the reply. Noise that the detection takes for speech also starts a
turn, and the gateway sends none for user.message text or for sessions in
which the client recognizes speech.

Voice.description: Voice is one selectable voice of a voice choice or synthesis model.

default.description:
Default marks the voice a session speaks with when SessionSetup.voice.name
is empty and the session language is one the voice speaks. A list has
either one default without a language or at most one default per
language; clients reject a list that mixes both. A list without a
default leaves the choice to the provider.

language.description:
Language is the ISO 639-1 code of the only language the voice speaks,
such as "fr". Clients offer the voice only in sessions whose language
tag has that base subtag, and session.setup rejects it in another.
Empty means the voice speaks every language the model does.

name.description: Name is the SessionSetup.voice.name that selects this voice.

VoiceChoice.description: VoiceChoice describes a selectable backend without exposing its credentials.

composable.description: Composable allows independent recognition and synthesis model selections.

id.description:
ID is the operator-configured id. It stays the same while the choice's
settings change, so clients save it; a saved id the catalog no longer
lists falls back to the default.

speechModes.description:
SpeechModes lists supported input/output ownership combinations.
Missing metadata from older gateways means transport defaults only.

voices.description:
Voices lists the selectable voices. Omitted when the choice does not
offer voice selection.

VoiceChoiceDefault.description:
VoiceChoiceDefault names the choice a transport family uses when a session
omits choiceID. A family is one transport: WebRTC audio for gateway speech,
or text for client speech with a gateway LLM.

id.description: ID names a choice that offers Transport.

transport.description: Transport is the family this default applies to.

VoiceChoicesResp.description:
VoiceChoicesResp advertises the available voice choices and one default per
offered family.

defaults.description: Defaults holds one entry per offered transport, ordered by transport name.

recognitionModels.description: RecognitionModels lists gateway recognition stages in preference order.

stunServers.description:
STUNServers lists the stun: or stuns: URLs a WebRTC client configures as
its ICE servers. Omitted means none: the client gathers host candidates
only and contacts no STUN server.

synthesisModels.description: SynthesisModels lists gateway synthesis stages in preference order.

language.description:
Language is the requested BCP 47 language tag, such as "en-US" or "fr-CA".
Empty defaults to "en-US"; an invalid tag fails session setup. A session
speaks one language, and the assistant replies in it. Synthesis and
recognition models that take a language receive it, recognition as a
hint or forced; other models ignore it. A model that declares its
languages fails session setup for another one. A model whose server
rejects the language fails when its connection starts: at session setup
for realtime choices, and at each utterance for recognition.

name.description:
Name is the requested voice name from the catalog's voices. Empty uses
the voice the catalog marks default for the session language, else the
configured voice, else the provider default. A voice of another language
fails session setup.

VoiceRTCAnswerResp.description: VoiceRTCAnswerResp is the response for POST /api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/offer.

sdp.description: SDP is the gateway WebRTC answer session description to pass to setRemoteDescription with type "answer".

sessionID.description: SessionID identifies the voice RTC session for diagnostics and close calls.

VoiceRTCClientDiagnostics.description: VoiceRTCClientDiagnostics reports client-observed WebRTC state for diagnosis.

dataChannelState.description: DataChannelState is the client's voice-gateway RTCDataChannel.readyState.

VoiceRTCConnectionState.description: VoiceRTCConnectionState is a WebRTC peer connection state.

VoiceRTCConnectivityIssue.description: VoiceRTCConnectivityIssue identifies a structured voice RTC connectivity issue.

VoiceRTCConnectivitySide.description: VoiceRTCConnectivitySide identifies where a voice RTC failure appears to be.

VoiceRTCDataChannelState.description: VoiceRTCDataChannelState is a WebRTC data channel state.

VoiceRTCDiagnosticsReq.description: VoiceRTCDiagnosticsReq is the request body for POST /api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/{sessionID}/diagnostics.

client.description: Client contains the browser/client WebRTC state observed by the caller.

VoiceRTCDiagnosticsResp.description: VoiceRTCDiagnosticsResp reports structured WebRTC connectivity diagnostics.

client.description: Client echoes the client diagnostics included in the request.

issue.description: Issue is the machine-readable connectivity diagnosis.

message.description: Message is a human-readable explanation of the diagnosis.

sessionID.description: SessionID is the diagnosed voice RTC session ID.

side.description: Side identifies where the issue appears to be.

VoiceRTCICEConnectionState.description: VoiceRTCICEConnectionState is a WebRTC ICE transport connection state.

VoiceRTCICEGatheringState.description: VoiceRTCICEGatheringState is a WebRTC ICE candidate gathering state.

VoiceRTCOfferReq.description: VoiceRTCOfferReq is the request body for POST /api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/offer.

choiceID.description: ChoiceID selects a gateway choice; empty uses the advertised default.

sdp.description: SDP is the browser/client WebRTC offer session description from RTCSessionDescription.sdp after createOffer and setLocalDescription.

service.description: Service authorizes a session on a standalone gateway. Embedded gateways use host authentication.

VoiceRTCServerDiagnostics.description: VoiceRTCServerDiagnostics reports server-observed WebRTC state for diagnosis.

audioTrackReceived.description: AudioTrackReceived reports whether the gateway received the client's microphone track.

backendConnected.description: BackendConnected reports whether the gateway connected to the configured voice backend.

connectionState.description: ConnectionState is the gateway PeerConnection aggregate connection state.

dataChannelOpened.description: DataChannelOpened reports whether the voice data channel reached open.

dataChannelState.description: DataChannelState is the gateway-observed voice data channel state.

iceConnectionState.description: ICEConnectionState is the gateway PeerConnection ICE connection state.

iceGatheringState.description: ICEGatheringState is the gateway PeerConnection ICE gathering state.

sessionFound.description: SessionFound reports whether the gateway still has the requested session.

sessionReadySent.description: SessionReadySent reports whether the gateway sent session.ready to the client.

signalingState.description: SignalingState is the gateway PeerConnection signaling state.

udpEndpoints.description: UDPEndpoints are the LAN/Tailscale and optional UPnP public UDP candidates advertised to the client.

udpMappingError.description: UDPMappingError is the last UPnP mapping or refresh error, if any.

VoiceRTCSignalingState.description: VoiceRTCSignalingState is a WebRTC peer connection signaling state.

VoiceRTCUDPEndpoint.description: VoiceRTCUDPEndpoint reports one server UDP candidate for diagnosis.

host.description: Host is an IP address advertised in the gateway SDP answer.

port.description: Port is the UDP port paired with host in the gateway SDP answer.

VoiceTextTicketReq.description:
VoiceTextTicketReq authorizes a browser text-session WebSocket upgrade.
Embedded hosts authenticate this HTTP request before dispatch.

choiceID.description: ChoiceID selects a text-capable choice, bound to the issued ticket.

service.description: Service authorizes a session on a standalone gateway.

VoiceTextTicketResp.description:
VoiceTextTicketResp carries a single-use ticket that expires after 30 seconds.
Connect to /api/voicegateway/v2/voice/text/browser with the
gomode.ticket.<ticket> WebSocket subprotocol alongside gomode.text.v2.
Never put it in a URL or store it persistently.

VoiceTransport.description:
VoiceTransport identifies how clients communicate with a voice choice.

- `text`: VoiceTransportText carries text with client speech recognition and synthesis.
- `webrtc`: VoiceTransportWebRTC carries audio through WebRTC.
